checks.why: a decorator matched only by its name that REGISTERS the function and hands it back unchanged: calling the decorated function never runs the decorator, so a change to what the decorator calls does not reach the decorated function (it used to be listed as a caller of the decorator, and everything reaching it with it)
the control: a decorator matched only by its name that hands back a WRAPPER. The decorated name now denotes the wrapper, so a change the wrapper reaches still reaches the decorated declaration
